exposure: GCSF group: GCSF + hCG injection + IUI
Control group: Normal saline + hCG injection + IUI
cohort: 320 eligible patients undergoing IUI at the referral infertility clinic of Shiraz University of Medical Sciences.
finding: Although not statistically significant, intrauterine administration of 300 mug GCSF simultaneously with hCG injection during standard IUI procedure might improve pregnancy outcomes.
